# azureacme_certificates (Data Source)

Every certificate registration visible to the caller, optionally filtered. Pagination is handled internally: the `items` list is complete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pagination is handled internally, so `items` is complete.
#
# Data sources are read at PLAN TIME on every run, so this one defaults to the
# summary view. Keep it that way unless you need the full projection.

data "azureacme_certificates" "expiring" {
  namespace       = "payments-prod"
  expiring_within = "30d"
}

output "expiring_soon" {
  value = [for c in data.azureacme_certificates.expiring.items : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `expiring_within` (String) A duration such as `30d`.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `namespace` (String) Restrict to one namespace. With no namespace, only namespaces the caller can read are listed.
- `status` (String)
- `view` (String) `summary` (default) or `full`. Data sources are read on every plan; keep them cheap.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
